body.name: Normalized jointly conjugate dual class
body.construction: \(\mathcal F_{K,d}^{\mathrm{joint}}=\{(f_1,\ldots,f_K):f_k:\mathbb B_d\to\mathbb R,\ f_k(x)=\inf_{(z_\ell)_{\ell\ne k}\in\mathbb B_d^{K-1}}[c_K(z_1,\ldots,z_{k-1},x,z_{k+1},\ldots,z_K)-\sum_{\ell\ne k}f_\ell(z_\ell)]\text{ for every }k,\ f_k(0)=0\text{ for }k<K\}\).
